title: 第9章 变天图
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

和铃一眼就看见了那个男人。

她眼底不免流露出一丝惊艳。原著只用寥寥几笔描绘了殷神凝的长相，这个时候，她脑子里面的印象忽然一下子变得尤为清晰。

晴岩飞雪，素净冷峻，乍见之下令人耳目夺魄，不敢久视。

这是原著《下神坛》中对殷神凝的描写。

换和铃自己来说的话，就是琅轩照夜，玉骨含章，一点也不像是人们刻板印象中的大魔头。

南华宗居然都不虐待他，她在这大魔头的身上真是一点伤痕都没瞧见。

不知道的还以为他是在这里隐居的世外高人呢。

和铃遥遥看着殷神凝，没有什么动作。

对方把她当空气，半点目光都没有给她。

无论进到炁字轮中的是老熟人还是陌生面孔，殷神凝都不在意。

他手指微抬，一团黑色的云气飘动，落在了纵横十九道白色云气的某一处交叉点上。

【和铃，这个男人你认识吗？】舔狗系统按捺不住好奇，先开口问道。

【你怎么知道水井底下有一个炁字印，里面还关押着人啊？他是你们南华宗囚禁在这儿的？】

小易淡淡道：【舔狗，这是阿铃的秘密，你就不要打听了，尊重宿主的隐私也是我们做系统的本分。】

舔狗系统一阵恼怒，【就显得你通情达理，体贴善良是吧？小绿茶。】

还有，舔狗这个名字是它能喊的吗？

它的全称叫舔狗无敌系统，简称的话那也是叫“无敌”好吗？

和铃按了按太阳穴，声音带着一丝冷意，“不要在我脑子里面吵架。”

两系统都瞬间安静下来。

宿主明显生气了，再闹下去又要挨批。

和铃来到殷神凝面前，单膝跪地，脸上绽放出来笑容，“前辈，我终于找到你了！”

两系统内心毫无波澜，毕竟宿主一向有两副面孔。

听她这浮夸的语气，怎么看也不是真心说这话的。面前的男子八成和她没什么关系。

她打的什么主意，舔狗系统和小易暂时都没看出来，但肯定有点别有用心的意味在里面。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

He Ling saw the man at a glance.

There was a hint of surprise in her eyes.The original work only used a few strokes to describe Yin Shenning's appearance. At this time, the impression in her mind suddenly became particularly clear.

The clear rocks and snowflakes are so pure and cold that it is so breathtaking at first sight that you dare not look at them for a long time.

This is the description of Yin Shenning in the original work "Xia Shentan".

If He Ling talks about it himself, Langxuan Zhaoye, with his jade bones and seals, does not look like the big devil in people's stereotype.

The Nanhua Sect didn't even abuse him. She really didn't see any scars on this big devil.

Those who didn’t know better thought he was an outsider who lived in seclusion here.

He Ling looked at Yin Shenning from a distance without making any movement.

The other party treated her like air and didn't even look at her.

No matter whether the person entering the Qi Zi Wheel was an old acquaintance or a strange face, Yin Shenning didn't care.

He raised his finger slightly, and a black cloud floated, landing on an intersection of nineteen white clouds.

[He Ling, do you know this man?】Licking Dog System couldn't restrain its curiosity and asked first.

[How do you know that there is a Qi seal under the well and that there are people imprisoned inside?Is he imprisoned here by your Nanhua Sect?】

Xiao Yi said calmly: [Licking the dog, this is A Ling's secret, so don't ask about it. Respecting the privacy of the host is also our duty as a system.】

The dog-licking system was annoyed for a while, [It makes you appear reasonable, considerate and kind, right?Little green tea.】

Also, is the name Licking Dog something it can call?

Its full name is Licking Dog Invincible System. If it's abbreviated, it's also called "Invincible", okay?

He Ling pressed his temples with a hint of coldness in his voice, "Don't argue in my head."

Both systems went silent instantly.

The host is obviously angry, and he will be criticized again if he continues to make trouble.

He Ling came to Yin Shenning, knelt down on one knee, and a smile broke out on his face, "Senior, I finally found you!"

There is no confusion between the two systems. After all, the host always has two faces.

Judging from her exaggerated tone, it seemed like she didn't really mean what she said.The man in front of her probably has nothing to do with her.

Neither Lingou System nor Xiao Yi could see what she had in mind for the time being, but there must be some ulterior motive in it.
